pin.estimand: token_delta over one complete stop directive for the same bounded task set: registered complete careful-English canonical stop template versus its finish-started or interrupt-started marker; population: cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base; 64 fresh directives, 32 per form, 8 scopes per form in each of downloads, print jobs, exports and analysis batches; aggregation: Maximum tokenizer mean of equally weighted finish-started and interrupt-started mean token differences (Ainglish minus English); member_span is the range of tokenizer means
admissibility_gates: every frozen English and Ainglish string is countable
Abort before encoding if the source, proposal revision, author advice or replication eligibility changes.
Abort if a declared tokenizer cannot load from the existing local cache; no downloads or substitute tokenizer.
File any finite supported, neutral or adverse result once; no response-contingent edits to pairs, templates, weights or roster.

planned_sample.meaning: 64 complete-pair realizations of 2 fixed templates, not 64 independent semantic effects
